title: OCT Eccentric Fixation and Amblyopia in Children
official: OCT Eccentric Fixation, Fixation Stability, and Amblyopia in Children
summary: The objectives of this proposal are to characterize the relationship between OCT eccentric fixation (OCT-EF), fixation eye movement (FEM), macular sensitivity in children with amblyopia.
sponsor: State University of New York College of Optometry
